liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Promised Land** (1 review, 1 other source): Mixed badly, with only Bobby's voice and some drums for roughly the first minute; The mix on Promised Land is a mess [1][17]
- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodeloo** (1 other source): A digital noise flaw occurs at 1:44 in Mississippi Half Step [4]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Bobby forgets lyrics to The Other One, as well as words elsewhere in the show [17]
- **Mind Left Body Jam** (1 review): The jam following The Other One is the Mind Left Body Jam, which was mislabeled [16]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Reviewer feels Row Jimmy kills the momentum of the Truckin' through Mind Left Body sequence [17]
- **Nobody's Fault Jam** (1 other source): A Nobody's Fault But Mine jam occurs inside Truckin' [1]

## The recordings

- **gd1974-05-12.150221.sbd.miller.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 25 songs; 175 min; rated 3.67/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd74-05-12.sbd.sacks.2224.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 162 min; rated 3.71/5 by 14 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the sound and mix are very good; Once it settles down, the sound is respectable; Sound is very good once the speakers stopped flying around [10][13][16]
- **gd1974-05-12.sbd.matt.22248.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 162 min; rated 3.29/5 by 7 [3]
- **gd1974-05-12.sbd.matrix-dts.tobin.90179.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 9 songs; 75 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]. Said about its sound: Described as a very nice Wall-of-Sound-era audience recording [4]
- **gd1974-05-12.sbd.matrix.tobin.90172.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 9 songs; 75 min; rated 3.67/5 by 3 [5]. Said about its sound: The matrix sounds muffled, as if played under a pillow or in a closet [18]

## Around the show

- Citing McNally's book, a strong Washoe zephyr blew through the outdoor show, spinning the Wall of Sound speakers overhead [11]
- Show fell on Mother's Day; the wind blew from behind the band toward the audience [12]
- Very windy day; Garcia reportedly said backstage that the band played scrappy [13]
- Windy day with the Wall of Sound swaying; the crowd was small [15]
- Attendee recalls a plane flying over during the jam and dropping something [15]
- Reviewer finds it a weak performance for 1974: strained vocals, forced jams and low energy [9]
- Reviewer calls it solid, with the best jam section of any show until 5/19 [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1974-05-12.150221.sbd.miller.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  June 18, 2020; source: SBD > Reel Master > DAT (44.1k) [1]. Also: Soundboard from reel master to cassette to DAT; audience source patches part of The Other One and Sugar Magnolia [1]
- **gd74-05-12.sbd.sacks.2224.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Master from Darrin Sacks: MSR to cassette to DAT to CDRs to EAC to SHN, previously uncirculated [2]
- **gd1974-05-12.sbd.matt.22248.shnf**: transferred by Matt; source: MSR>C>DAT>CDRs>EAC>SHN [3]. Also: Copy had zero-padding on track ends; an archive.org user trimmed it, stitched discs in Cool Edit Pro and re-cut tracks in 2003 [3]
- **gd1974-05-12.sbd.matrix-dts.tobin.90179.flac16**: source: DTS Audio 5.1; SBD (shn id 2224) MSR>C>DAT>CDRs>EAC>SHN + AUD (shn id 10529)AUD>?>CDRs>EAC>SHN Shns supplied by Jack Warner - dts mixing by Kevin Tobin [4]. Also: Matrix DTS mix aligns soundboard and audience sources in Audition 3.0, with a Surcode DTS encode [4]
- **gd1974-05-12.sbd.matrix.tobin.90172.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shn id 2224) MSR> C> DAT> CDRs> EAC> SHN; via Darrin Sacks + AUD (shn id 10529) Partial 2nd Set; AUD>?>CD; via Jack Warner - matrix… [5]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by SoundCloud: [Ship of Fools (Live at University of Nevada, Reno, NV, 5/12/74)](https://soundcloud.com/gratefuldead/ship-of-fools-live-at) [22]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead University of Nevada - May 12, 1974](https://www.dead.net/show/may-12-1974) [23]
- Photo by Tom Carrigan (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead Wall of Sound University of Nevada Reno 5-12-1974](https://www.flickr.com/photos/151728916@N08/48144262776/) [24]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/151728916@N08/48144262776/) [25]
